name: Escape Waves Brainrot Evolution
desc:
🌊 The Waves are rising… and only Brainrots can outrun extinction!

🧠 Play as insane Brainrots and escape the deadly wave!
🧬 With every level, your Brainrot evolves into stronger and crazier forms.
⚡ Train your speed, break through dangerous obstacles, and survive the chaos!
🐾 Collect pets to massively boost your speed and progress faster.
🏆 Earn wins, unlock new worlds, and witness the ultimate Brainrot evolution!

⭐ Like the game
❤️ Favorite it
🔥 Become the final Brainrot standing.
